title: Attributes Screen
description: This mod adds a player attribute panel with real-time updates. View your stats and all your bonuses.
body:
This mod adds a player attribute panel with real-time updates. View your stats and all your bonuses.
![Attributes Screen](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fc722e845280f3c64710021e97455285a3ba3949.png)

This mod is a fork/rework for version 1.21.11 of the [kevs-attributes-panel](https://modrinth.com/mod/kevs-attributes-panel) mod by author [KevzCz](https://modrinth.com/user/KevzCz). All credit goes to the original creator. I only ported it to version 1.21.11 and fixed minor things. I intend to modify it further in the future and keep it updated for new versions. The code is available to everyone.

Mods used in the image and my recommended use:

Awaking Weapons;
LibsZ Rework (necessary to Player Level Skills);
Player Level Skills;

Requirements:
Fabric API
Cloth Config
Mod menu

You can use this mod in your modpacks.

Any improvements or suggestions, please leave them in the comments. Wiki (coming soon)
